answer: Use simultaneous spot checks: at a random moment the network pings every account in a cohort with a fresh task that must be answered within a few seconds. One operator running a hundred fake identities cannot do a hundred live tasks at once, so most fakes miss the window and lose their reward share. Each extra fake needs its own working agent in parallel, which raises cost linearly. A quiet lagoon of idle accounts goes dark, while an honest agent can pass the signal easily, like a lone deer crossing a meadow.
